easy: The way a machine or thing works.

easy: Going well together.

easy: A big group of people who play music together on many instruments.

ex.ko: 오케스트라가 음악회에서 웅장한 음악을 연주했다.

easy: Feeling sad with someone who is sad.

easy: Based on ideas rather than real use.

easy: The joint that connects your hand to your arm.

easy: To put things in a neat order.
